query: Florida Department of Health dengue arboviral surveillance report June 2025
query_rationale: FDOH is the primary authoritative source for Florida dengue case counts, deaths, hospitalizations, and locality data. Targeting FDOH surveillance reports with natural-language time reference 'June 2025' and disease-specific term 'arboviral' (FDOH uses this umbrella term for dengue reporting) maximizes retrieval of the most relevant official documents. This replaces the upstream q_exec_001/q_exec_002 which used an unnatural date-range string unlikely to match document text.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: FDOH Arboviral Disease Surveillance report, weekly/monthly epidemiological summary, or disease activity report for June 2025 listing dengue case counts by county or statewide.
expected_trust_signal: Florida Department of Health (.fdoh.gov or .myflorida.com domain), official surveillance program authorship, tabular case count data with date ranges.

query: CDC ArboNET dengue cases Florida 2025 surveillance data
query_rationale: CDC ArboNET is the national arboviral surveillance system that aggregates state-reported dengue data including Florida. CDC also publishes dengue case counts by state. This query targets CDC's dengue surveillance pages and ArboNET data tables, which may include June 2025 Florida case counts, confirmed/probable breakdowns, and deaths. Complements FDOH data and provides cross-validation.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC dengue surveillance summary, ArboNET data table, or CDC dengue statistics page showing Florida case counts for 2025 (ideally broken down by month or including June).
expected_trust_signal: CDC.gov domain, ArboNET program attribution, tabular state-level case count data.

query: PAHO WHO dengue situation report United States Florida June 2025
query_rationale: PAHO publishes regional dengue situation reports that include US case data, sometimes with state-level breakdowns. These serve as independent validation of FDOH/CDC figures and may contain evidence quotes, case definitions, and hospitalization/death data. Refines upstream q_exec_003/q_exec_004 by using natural language time reference and explicit PAHO/WHO agency names.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: PAHO epidemiological alert or dengue situation report for the Americas covering June 2025, referencing US or Florida dengue case counts.
expected_trust_signal: PAHO.org or WHO.int domain, official situation report format, epidemiological week references.

query: dengue cases Florida June 2025 health department report
query_rationale: News and media reports may surface dengue case counts, outbreak alerts, or official statements from FDOH or local health departments for June 2025 that are not yet indexed as official documents. Useful for identifying specific localities, dates, and case counts cited from official sources, and for discovering links to primary official reports. Refines upstream q_exec_009 with natural language time reference and without unnatural date-range string.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: News article, press release, or health alert from June 2025 reporting dengue cases in Florida, ideally citing FDOH or CDC figures with specific case counts, county-level data, or death/hospitalization information.
expected_trust_signal: Bylined journalism citing official health agency sources, press releases from FDOH or county health departments, publication date within June 2025.

query: site:floridahealth.gov "2025-23-arbovirus" OR "week 23" OR "2025-26-arbovirus" OR "week 26" dengue June 2025
query_rationale: The FDOH surveillance index (rank 8) explicitly lists Week 23 (June 7–13) and Week 22 (May 31–Jun 6). Week 23 PDF and Week 26 PDF (June 22–28) are not confirmed retrieved. These two weekly reports cover the heart of the June 2025 window and are needed to complete the weekly series. Targeting floridahealth.gov with week-number identifiers maximizes retrieval of these specific PDFs.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: FDOH weekly arbovirus surveillance PDF for epidemiological week 23 (June 7–13, 2025) and/or week 26 (June 22–28, 2025) with dengue case counts, travel-associated vs. locally acquired breakdown, county-level data.
expected_trust_signal: floridahealth.gov domain, PDF filename pattern matching 2025-23 or 2025-26, official FDOH surveillance program authorship.
previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q1 — FDOH surveillance index (rank 8) lists week 23 but PDF not confirmed retrieved; week 26 absent from candidates

query: Florida dengue week 23 week 24 week 25 week 26 arbovirus surveillance 2025 PDF
query_rationale: Broadens the FDOH weekly PDF search across all four epidemiological weeks that fall within June 2025 (weeks 23–26). The site: operator in iter2_q1 may miss PDFs indexed via third-party aggregators or cached versions. This general web query uses week numbers and 'PDF' to surface direct links to the FDOH weekly reports or mirrors (e.g., pascomosquito.org, epi.ufl.edu) that may have cached or linked these specific weekly PDFs.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: Direct PDF links or pages referencing FDOH arbovirus surveillance weeks 23–26 for 2025, with dengue case counts per week.
expected_trust_signal: floridahealth.gov PDF URLs, or secondary sources (pascomosquito.org, epi.ufl.edu) linking to or summarizing FDOH weekly reports for weeks 23–26.
previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q1 — weeks 23 and 26 PDFs not confirmed retrieved; week 24 and 25 PDFs present but content gaps remain

query: CDC dengue United States 2025 cases by state Florida confirmed probable deaths hospitalizations
query_rationale: CDC.gov returned 6 results in iteration 1 but no snippet confirmed Florida-specific June 2025 dengue counts with deaths or hospitalizations. CDC publishes dengue case statistics by state (via ArboNET and the dengue statistics page at cdc.gov/dengue). This query targets CDC's state-level breakdown for 2025, which may include Florida confirmed/probable case counts, deaths, and hospitalizations — fields not yet evidenced in any snippet. This is the primary remaining gap for deaths/hospitalizations.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC dengue statistics page or ArboNET summary table showing Florida 2025 case counts broken down by confirmed/probable, with deaths and hospitalizations columns.
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain, ArboNET or dengue surveillance program attribution, tabular state-level data with case classification and outcome fields.
previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q2 — CDC returned 6 results but no Florida-specific June 2025 deaths/hospitalizations confirmed in snippets

query: Florida dengue death hospitalization June 2025 locally acquired travel-associated county
query_rationale: Deaths and hospitalizations are not evidenced in any current snippet. News and outbreak reporting sources (e.g., outbreaknewstoday, heraldtribune — both present in iteration 1 results) may have reported on dengue deaths or hospitalizations in Florida during June 2025, particularly for locally acquired cases (which are rarer and more newsworthy). Adding 'locally acquired' and 'county' terms targets the most newsworthy and locality-specific events. This complements the official FDOH/CDC queries and may surface evidence quotes with specific outcome data.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: News article or press release from June 2025 reporting dengue death(s) or hospitalization(s) in Florida, citing FDOH or county health department, with specific case counts, county, and date.
expected_trust_signal: Bylined journalism with publication date in June 2025, citing FDOH or county health department as source, specific numeric claims for deaths or hospitalizations.
previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q4 — deaths and hospitalizations not evidenced in any snippet; outbreaknewstoday and heraldtribune present in results but content not confirmed
